task_title: 곡면 grid offset/mesh/smoothing 폭 물리 수렴

physics_configuration.base: the G3-04 cylinder fixture (2D, radius 0.3 um, n = 1.5, domain 3.2 um, PML 0.4 um, TFSF box 1.6 um, monitors at 1.1 um, 1.3 to 1.8 um in nine samples, 120 fs), TM (Ez) and TE (Ey), CPU FP64
physics_configuration.a_staircase: scattering width error against Mie at h, h/2, h/4 with the staircase interface
physics_configuration.c_shift: cylinder centre shifted along x by 0, h/4 and h/2 at the fixed mesh above, staircase and subpixel; the TFSF box and monitors stay fixed, so any change of the width is grid-registration error
physics_configuration.d_smoothing: DifferentiableSolid.cylinder rasterised by smooth_geometry_epsilon at the Yee positions with transition width w = fraction x h, injected into the standard TFSF solver through the voxelize hook of torchfdtd.solver (test-side override, same solver, same source and monitors); off the contour the vanishing width reproduces the staircase image exactly, while samples lying on the contour to 1e-9 um (four Ez nodes at h = 0.05 um for the 0.3 um radius) take the documented half value, so the vanishing-width row is a second staircase variant and its difference from row (a) is recorded
physics_configuration.cost_metric: single-run wall seconds of Simulation.run including preparation, on a shared workstation; reported as a diagnostic only

reference_method: the infinite-cylinder Mie series of tests/test_physics_g3_b.py (see G3-04)

observables.name: max_relative_error
observables.definition: max over the nine wavelengths of |width/Mie - 1| for each row

observables.name: convergence_order_estimates
observables.definition: log2 of the ratio of successive max_relative_error values of a mesh sequence

observables.name: max_relative_error_spread
observables.definition: largest minus smallest max_relative_error over the three centre shifts

observables.name: width_variation_relative
observables.definition: largest per-wavelength spread of the width over the shifts divided by the mean width

observables.name: max_relative_difference_from_staircase
observables.definition: max over wavelengths of |width(w)/width(staircase) - 1| for a smoothing width w

acceptance_limits.pass_fail: subpixel max_relative_error at h = 0.05 um is below the staircase max_relative_error at h = 0.05 um for the centred cylinder, for TM and for TE
acceptance_limits.sharp_limit: the w = 1e-6 h image equals the staircase image at every sample off the contour and takes the half value on the contour; the resulting width difference from row (a) is recorded, not limited
acceptance_limits.reported_not_judged: convergence order estimates, monotonicity, shift spreads, the smoothing-width sweep and whether the subpixel error at h is below the staircase error at h/2 at lower wall time
acceptance_limits.source_of_limits: fixture-specific expectation declared here; no second-order or monotone criterion is imposed on staircased curved surfaces

applicable_scope: Layer B convergence study of the G3-04 cylinder on CPU FP64 only: staircase and subpixel mesh sequences, sub-cell centre shifts and the differentiable-solid transition width through the standard TFSF solver. re-recorded on a5ae4ef4bec3 for the release candidate.
verification_reason: no failures or errors, and no required test skipped or absent
